channel.title: MurOS News
channel.description: Release notes and announcements for MurOS, the Debian-based firewall.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.74 released
item.description: Multi-WAN failover between the tiers of a gateway group, including the connections already open, per source connection limits on the firewall rules, host discovery on a packet socket, power savings mapped to the cpufreq governors, monit driving the Debian daemon, and the netstat diagnostics rebuilt on the Linux counters.

item.title: MurOS 0.9.41 released
item.description: Refreshed branding across the web UI, captive portal and installer, plus the usual round of fixes for the Debian platform.

item.title: Installer ISO updated
item.description: A fresh offline installer image is available from the download page. It ships the current MurOS build and needs no network access to install.

item.title: Getting started with MurOS
item.description: New to MurOS? The documentation covers installation, interface assignment and your first firewall rules.
